name: Olympia Industries Limited
summary: Olympia Industries Ltd. specializes in online marketing and promotional services delivered via e-commerce channels. The firm caters to a diverse range of sectors, including automotive, infant care, home and kitchen products, apparel, gourmet and specialty food items, beauty and personal care, and sports. Its comprehensive product selection encompasses automotive maintenance supplies, vehicle tires and tools, baby clothing, carriers, and toys, various kitchenware such as cutlery and bakeware, casual wear, herbs, spices, snack foods, personal grooming devices like curling irons and hair clippers, alongside sports gadgets, footwear, and activewear. Founded on November 10, 1987, the company is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
